steps.text: Same bottle settings as the user's Highball reference bottle for Steam: DXMT as the bottle renderer (D3D11 only; SSFIV.exe is D3D9 and goes to DXVK d3d9), msync for games, win10. Steam itself is not installed by this recipe: the adapter copies a signed-in Steam folder into the bottle, or run Highball's own steam.json recipe on the bottle first.
